message.content:
Adam Smith's condition for Li Hua to add decorations to the basement, specifically artwork on the walls, is that they must be hung without causing damage to the walls. Adam advises using removable hooks to ensure the integrity of the walls is maintained. This guidance demonstrates Adam Smith's consideration for Li Hua's residence and his willingness to ensure that Li Hua can personalize and decorate the space safely and responsibly.

```
AdamSmith: Hi Li Hua! I'm glad to hear you're settling in well. You can hang your artwork as long as you don't damage the walls. Just use removable hooks. Enjoy your decorating!
LiHua: Thanks for the info! I’ll make sure to be careful. Can't wait to show you the finished look!
AdamSmith: Looking forward to seeing it! I'm sure it will look great."
```

Adam provided this condition in conversation number 11 on June 1, 2026. This approach by Adam helps maintain the property while allowing Li Hua to express their personal style.
